description:
YARG is an Open-Source plastic band rhythm game! 
Play through the YARG Official Setlist for the crowd,
and maybe get some free items from your fans!

26.09.13.description:
Oh lord it has been 4 months. Here we go.

All apworlds now require YARG AP Client 1.0.0 or newer.

# New Release - Band Hero
# New Release - Guitar Hero 3
- Includes additional setlist "GH3 Co-op" containing 5 songs.
-- Guitar Battle vs. Slash
-- Guitar Battle vs. Tom Morello
-- One (Co-op version)
-- The Devil Went Down to Georgia
-- Through the Fire and Flames (Co-op Version)
# New Release - Guitar Hero Warriors of Rock
# All Setlists - Big Content Update
- Added Band Hero
- Added Guitar Hero 3
- Added GH3 Co-op
- Added Guitar Hero Warriors of Rock
- Added YARN Request Pack 2
- Added Whiteweek 01
- Added Luge 01
- Added Pronoun Palace 01
- Added YARN Request Pack 3
- Added YARN Pack 5
- Added Teto Pack 2
- Added Variety Pack 1
- Added Go Down in History
- Updated YARG Official Setlist to add support for Wave 16

With this update, there are now over 1,000 songs supported by this project.
26.09.13.title: The Long Awaited Guitar Hero and Rock Band Update
